notes: Quillayute Valley School District No. 402 Proposition No. 1 is scoped SCHDST '402' (WA DOR SCH2025, layer 20, DISTATTRIB), the district's Jefferson County part (West End).
Clallam County Fire Protection District No. 1 Proposition No. 1 is scoped FIRDST '9': WA DOR FIR2025 (layer 7) numbers the district's Jefferson County part '9'.
County Commissioner District 3 and Public Utility District No. 1 Commissioner District 2 are elected county-wide in the general; PUD No. 1 of Jefferson County covers the whole county.
